items.title: Harry Fairconnetue Interview, 1962-11-11
items.q: The interviewee's name is Harry Fairconnetue. The interviewer mentions 'Joe LaFell Jackson' (Joe B) as the interviewer's own nickname. There is no interaction or relationship described between the interviewee and Joe LaFell Jackson.

ctx.x: All right, let's get your name again so they can hear it.
That's Joe LaFell Jackson. A lot of people around here call me Joe B. Joe B, that's right. Yeah, but there's no B in my name. It's just a nickname you might put it.
You're better known by Joe B.
